name: Franz
blurb: Franz is your messaging app / former Emperor of Austria and combines chat and messaging services into one application.
description: Franz is your messaging app / former Emperor of Austria and combines chat and messaging services into one application. Franz currently supports Slack, WhatsApp, WeChat, HipChat, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, Google Hangouts,GroupMe, Skype and many more.
